_comment: Pinned native binaries. SHA-256 values come from the digests GitHub publishes for each release asset and are re-verified on every fetch.

tessdata._comment: tessdata_fast language files from github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (main). SHA-256 values were computed on 2026-10-19 from the downloads and are re-verified on every fetch.

verapdf._comment: veraPDF greenfield installer (command line only). The address always serves the newest release; the hash was computed on 2026-10-20 from the download and is re-verified on every fetch. A new release means a new hash: review it, then update this pin.
